entities.name: Alma Adamkienė
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alma Adamkienė was a Lithuanian philologist and philanthropist. She was the wife of the president of Lithuania, Valdas Adamkus, and was First Lady during his two terms. She also held United States citizenship.
